guide.about_desc: Istuudiyo furan oo loogu talagalay u adeegida Qur'aanka Kariimka iyo culuumtiisa, si loo helo saxnaan sare oo lagu waafajiyo codadka iyo qoraallada.
guide.feature_1_desc: Taageero buuxda oo offline ah oo loogu talagalay 604 bog oo farta rasmiga ah.
guide.feature_2_desc: Taageerada aayadaha, xadiisyada, cutubyada, iyo qoraallada gaarka ah.
guide.feature_3_desc: Faylal fudud (~1KB) oo xisaabiya Juska iyo Bogagga si toos ah.
guide.workflow_step1_desc: Riix Open audio file si aad u doorato codka (.mp3, .m4a, .wav).
guide.workflow_step2_desc: Riix Fetch Quran si aad u doorato suuradda iyo bogga Musxafka.
guide.workflow_step3_desc: Daar codka (Space), riix Enter bilowga aayadda iyo Enter dhammaadkeeda.
guide.workflow_step4_desc: Riix Export si aad u hesho JSON ama Dart code loogu talagalay Flutter.
guide.tip_1_desc: Hagaaji waqtiga dib-u-dhaca (150-250ms) si looga jaro waqtiga la diiwaangeliyey.
guide.tip_2_desc: Riixidda Ctrl+Z waxay tirtiraysaa qaybtii ugu dambaysay waxayna soo celinaysaa aayadii hore.
guide.tip_3_desc: Isticmaal badhamada [Hore / Ka bood] si aad u maamusho aayadaha.
guide.dont_show_again: Ha soo bandhigin daaqadan si toos ah bilowga
